lede: Pittsburgh Steelers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#19 in EPA per play), while Cleveland Browns owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#6 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Pittsburgh Steelers −5.0 with a fair total of 38.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cleveland Browns pass offence vs Pittsburgh Steelers pass defence, which sits −0.207 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
